title: Tissue Engineering for Hair Follicle Regeneration
brief_summary: This study is to try to maintain cultured dermal papilla cells in spherical structure in vitro before transplanting into dermis in vivo. Also, this study is aimed in clarifying actual mechanism of inducing hair follicle by dermal papilla cells.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients receiving cosmetic surgeries such as removal of moles

Exclusion Criteria:

* No special exclusion criteria
